query: Show users from New York that have premium accounts
reference_sql: SELECT id, first_name, last_name FROM users WHERE city = 'New York' AND is_premium = true

query: List the categories in the Electronics department
reference_sql: SELECT id, name FROM categories WHERE department = 'Electronics'

query: Find the average price of products in the Electronics department
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(p.price) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.department = 'Electronics'

query: How many reviews were written for each product? Show product id and name.
reference_sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, COUNT(r.id) FROM products p LEFT JOIN reviews r ON p.id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name

query: Show the names of products that have at least 3 reviews with a rating of 5
reference_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.rating = 5 GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING COUNT(r.id) >= 3
